statement: Identify the authors of a dataset.
Describe the lineage of a dataset.
Give potential data consumers information on how to use the data (usage notes).
source_passage: Ability to give potential data consumers information on how to use the data

statement: Link a dataset to scientific publications about it.
source_passage: Ability to link to scientific publications about a dataset.

statement: Link a dataset to its input data (the data used to create it).
source_passage: Ability to link to input data (i.e., data used to create a dataset).

statement: Use persistent identifiers for dataset authors and input data, so datasets can be reliably filtered and linked by them.
source_passage: a key requirement is the ability to rely on persistent identifiers

statement: Encode identifiers as HTTP URIs wherever possible.
source_passage: it would be desirable to promote the encoding of identifiers as HTTP URIs, whenever possible

statement: Distinguish primary identifiers (e.g. DOIs) from alternative ones.
source_passage: DCAT-AP already provides a mechanism to model primary and secondary identifiers, as well as the identifier type.

statement: Use a DOI as the dataset identifier when generating DataCite citations.
source_passage: DataCite requires the dataset identifier to be a DOI.

statement: Qualify each identifier with its scheme or type.
source_passage: DCAT-AP already provides a mechanism to model primary and secondary identifiers, as well as the identifier type.

statement: Use a minimal, consistent set of unambiguous agent roles beyond publisher and contact point.
source_passage: identifying a minimal set of unambiguous roles and promote their use would be preferable

statement: Indicate when a distribution points to a service or API rather than directly to the data.
source_passage: Denote distributions as pointing to a service / API, and not directly to the actual data.

statement: Describe the API or service interface, with the query parameters needed to select data, so software agents can use it directly.
source_passage: Provide a description of the API / service interface, along with the relevant query parameters

statement: Describe provenance in enough detail to support reproducibility and to track how data are used.
source_passage: The objectives include (a) data reproducibility and (b) ability to track the usage of data

statement: Describe data quality assessments of a dataset.
Include users' feedback on the data as quality information.
source_passage: it potentially includes the integration of users' feedback as part of the meta/data management life-cycle.
